headline: Incyte (INCY) Reports Full Latarcibart Data And Buys Vega Therapeutics
summary: Incyte (NasdaqGS:INCY) reported full safety and efficacy results from its Phase 1/2 study of latarcibart, a once monthly subcutaneous therapy for von Willebrand disease. The company announced the acquisition of VGA039 (latarcibart) through the purchase of Vega Therapeutics to support further development.
